title: Personal Credit Cards: when billed interest may be reversed
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: interest charge reversals

This policy covers the reversal of interest already billed on a Personal Credit Cards account: the courtesy reversal of residual (trailing) interest, the reversal of interest billed in error, and the rule that one interest charge is reversed at most once.

## Policy clauses

1. **Residual interest courtesy.** Residual interest billed on the statement after the cardholder paid a statement balance in full, for the days between that statement's closing date and the payment date, may be reversed in full on the courtesy waiver ground, up to the tier's courtesy allowance for residual interest in a rolling 365 days.
2. The allowance is counted per customer across all of the customer's card accounts, as the number of courtesy interest reversals posted in the 365 calendar days ending on the current date, inclusive.
3. A courtesy reversal of residual interest requires that the statement balance it follows was paid in full.
4. **Bank error.** Interest billed at a rate or on a balance contrary to the Personal Credit Cards charter is reversed on the bank error ground, without limit.
5. **Once only.** An interest charge can be reversed at most once.

## Decision table for a courtesy reversal of residual interest

| The statement balance it follows was paid in full | Courtesy interest reversals in the rolling 365 days are below the tier allowance | The charge has not been reversed before | Courtesy reversal |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | may be granted, in full |
| no | any | any | not on the courtesy ground |
| any | no | any | not on the courtesy ground |
| any | any | no | no further reversal of that charge |

All three facts are read from the bank's records of the card's transactions and statement balance.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical customer, allowance of 1 used as an example)

- The customer's only courtesy interest reversal posted 200 days ago on another of the customer's cards: the count is 1, not below 1, so no courtesy reversal is available now.
- The same reversal posted 400 days ago: it falls outside the rolling window, the count is 0, and a courtesy reversal may be granted if the other conditions hold.
- Interest billed at a rate the charter does not allow is reversed on the bank error ground regardless of how many courtesy reversals the customer has used.

**Q: Can a residual interest charge be reversed in part?**
A: The courtesy reversal of residual interest is in full.
